title: MS-Point: Multi-Modal Hierarchical Spectral Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.25282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Point-image alignment learns useful object representations, but different local feature patterns can produce the same pooled descriptor and receive the same alignment signal. We introduce MS-Point, a cross-modal pretraining framework that directly supervises intermediate point features and their neighborhood responses. At selected encoder stages, we compute neighborhood averages and residuals before pooling and align their branch descriptors with image features. Branch-level objectives align each representation with its visual target, while cross-level consistency and adaptive fusion coordinate information across branches. A common interface of intermediate features and spatial neighborhoods supports both graph encoders and point Transformers. Evaluations across object classification, few-shot adaptation, dense prediction, and low-label scene learning demonstrate the transfer value of this design. Same-backbone comparisons and capacity-m

translated_title: MS-Point：面向点云理解的多模态分层谱学习
translated_abstract: 点-图像对齐能够学习到有用的物体表示，但不同的局部特征模式可能产生相同的池化描述符，从而接收到相同的对齐信号。我们提出了MS-Point，这是一个跨模态预训练框架，可直接监督中间点特征及其邻域响应。在选定的编码器阶段，我们在池化之前计算邻域平均值和残差，并将其分支描述符与图像特征进行对齐。分支级目标使每个表示与其视觉目标对齐，同时跨层一致性和自适应融合协调各分支间的信息。中间特征与空间邻域的通用接口同时支持图编码器和点Transformer。在物体分类、少样本适应、密集预测和低标注场景学习等多项任务上的评估证明了该设计的迁移价值。相同骨干网络下的对比以及容量相关（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: MS-Point提出了一种跨模态预训练框架，通过在池化前直接监督中间点特征及其邻域响应，结合分支级对齐、跨层一致性与自适应融合，突破了传统点-图像对齐中不同局部模式产生相同池化描述符的局限，并兼容图编码器与点Transformer等多种骨干架构。
en_tdlr: MS-Point is a cross-modal pretraining framework that directly supervises intermediate point features and neighborhood responses before pooling, using branch-level alignment, cross-level consistency, and adaptive fusion to overcome the ambiguity of pooled descriptors, while supporting both graph encoders and point Transformers.
